title: FMCSA Active U.S. Company Census Principal Offices
description: Governed daily FMCSA Company Census layer for source-designated active U.S./territory registrations with deliverable principal-office addresses, USDOT and authority identifiers, classifications, ZIP/ZCTA context, provenance, privacy minimization, and explicit gaps.
coverage_claim: FMCSA registrations with STATUS_CODE=A, PHY_COUNTRY=US, and an accepted reported principal-office address in a supported U.S. state or territory; not every business, carrier location, vehicle base, storefront, or proof of status outside FMCSA scope.
